Franka collision STL visuals replaced by existing detailed DAE visuals with the same visual transforms.
Flexiv source material Kd retained as linear reflectance; cyan ring appearance follows official product reference.

RAPID: official complete STL/URDF replaces primitive visuals. Native URDF only defines generic grey; neutral satin alloy finish selected for the figure, not claimed as an official coating.

Franka/xArm7: white coated bodies and black joints; Flexiv silver metallic body / white end caps / cyan rings; KUKA orange enamel covers / silver metal. Roughness is visual tuning, not measured manufacturer BRDF.
Native hand assemblies use their authored/default open poses, aligned to the original experiment palm base at metric scale. Static illustration, not policy rollout.

Current official xArm7 xacro explicitly uses White for link_base and links 1-6 and Silver for link 7; use this matching material assignment rather than transplanting finishes from another product revision.

derived_rapid_render_asset.change: Complete camera assembly and fixed bracket removed from the BASE visual mesh; retained source triangles and all finger meshes verified unchanged; original articulated URDF retained.
